subject.title: fix(agents): bound IDENTITY.md reads to prevent OOM

question: Should workspace identity loading intentionally treat files over 1 MiB and symlinked or otherwise non-regular `IDENTITY.md` paths as missing identity?
rationale: The memory bound is sound, but the selected repository helper also rejects file shapes that current users may rely on, and the existing catch makes that compatibility change silent.

options.title: Accept bounded regular files
options.body: Adopt the 1 MiB regular-file-only policy and merge with the current proof and tests.

options.title: Add a visible diagnostic
options.body: Keep the bounded regular-file policy but surface a warning or doctor finding when identity loading is rejected.

options.title: Preserve symlink behavior
options.body: Use a bounded read implementation that follows the existing supported target shape while still preventing unbounded allocation.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded regular files
recommendation.body: Adopt the 1 MiB regular-file-only policy and merge with the current proof and tests.
